assetSlots.label: ring_bloom (연출 소품)
assetSlots.prompt: Hero prop: a bioluminescent space flower wrapped by a tilted orbital ring, like a tiny planet-flower. Center: a cluster of 8-10 luminous translucent petals (teal #1FA6A0 base fading to light mint #BFF5E3 tips, subtle violet #7A5CE0 veins, emissive edges) around a glowing gold-amber #F2B64C crystal-seed core. Stem stub and two small leaves in deep teal #0E5E6F glass. A thin polished brass orbital ring (with 3 small crystal seed beads riding on it) circles the bloom at ~20 degrees tilt, slightly wider than the flower. Materials: frosted glass petals with emissive rim, polished brass ring, faceted amber crystal core. Clean readable silhouette from front view, ~1.6 units wide when open. Animation 'open' (~1.2 s): petals start closed as a bud, then unfurl outward with slight overshoot, while the brass ring spins one full turn around the bloom and keeps rotating slowly to the end. No text, no logos.

assetSlots.label: crystal_seed (연출 파티클)
assetSlots.prompt: Small particle: a luminous crystal seed, teardrop/almond shape with 6-8 clean facets, ~0.3 units long. Translucent teal #1FA6A0 crystal body with a glowing light-mint #BFF5E3 inner core and a tiny polished brass cap at the narrow end (like a seed husk). Subtle violet #7A5CE0 rim tint. Low poly (<300 tris), readable silhouette when spinning, emissive core so it reads on navy #081A2C background. No text.

assetSlots.label: luminous_petal (연출 파티클)
assetSlots.prompt: A single small bioluminescent flower petal for an orbital greenhouse space garden. Teardrop/elongated oval shape with a gentle curl and a slightly cupped surface, thin but with visible thickness for 3D readability. Material: semi-translucent luminous petal with subsurface glow, gradient from light mint #BFF5E3 at the tip to teal #1FA6A0 at the base, a faint violet #7A5CE0 rim and a fine glowing central vein. Low-poly friendly (under 300 tris), clean silhouette from all angles, no text, no candy look.

assetSlots.label: glow_tendril (연출 파티클)
assetSlots.prompt: A small curling glowing vine tendril for a bioluminescent space botany theme: a spiral-curled stem segment (about 1.5 turns) with one tiny leaf bud near the base. Material: luminous teal #1FA6A0 stem with emissive mint #BFF5E3 core glow, a fine polished brass #F2B64C ring band at the base as a garden-tech accent, soft violet #7A5CE0 tint at the curled tip. Reads clearly as a living light-vine when shown many times flying in a stream. Low-poly friendly (under 400 tris), no text.
